name: Kerala Beef Fry (Nadan Erachi Ularthiyathu)
instructions: 1. Marinate the beef with turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, pepper, salt, and ginger-garlic paste for 30 minutes.
2. Pressure cook the beef with minimal water until tender (approx. 4-5 whistles).
3. Heat coconut oil in a heavy-bottomed pan or earthen pot (manchatti) and fry the coconut slices until golden brown.
4. Add sliced onions, curry leaves, and green chilies, sautéing until the onions turn golden brown.
5. Add the cooked beef to the pan and fry on medium-low heat, stirring continuously.
6. Sprinkle garam masala and more black pepper powder, continuing to fry until the meat turns dark brown and dry.
7. Remove from heat and serve hot.
description: Nadan Erachi Ularthiyathu is a quintessential Kerala dish, characterized by the intense aroma of curry leaves and coconut oil. It is deeply embedded in the culinary culture of Kerala, often served with Kerala Parotta or appam, and represents the traditional spice-heavy flavor profile of the region.
